title: CrewAI autolog credential key filter: drop keys matching _SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN, matching token only as a whole word or camelCase suffix so max_tokens and tokenizer are kept
answers: Why are max_tokens or tokenizer missing from my CrewAI LLM span attributes?
Which CrewAI LLM or agent fields are hidden from traces, such as auth_token or client_secret?
How do I make a new CrewAI config field get skipped as a secret in autolog?
body:
Path: mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN is the single key-name filter used by _set_sanitized_attribute, _get_agent_attributes, _get_task_attributes and _get_llm_attributes, and it also applies to dict keys inside _sanitize_value.
Rule: A key is treated as a credential if it contains api_key/apikey, secret, password, authorization or credential anywhere, or if it is token as a standalone or snake_case suffix (auth_token, TOKEN) or ends in camelCase Token (accessToken, BearerToken). Keys such as max_tokens, tokenizer and token_usage are not matched. When adding a field, check the key name against this pattern rather than adding an api_key-only skip.
Symptom: Credentials such as auth_token, client_secret or Authorization on a CrewAI LLM or agent were written as plain string span attributes, because the value is a string that _sanitize_value cannot recognize as sensitive; the earlier filter only skipped api_key.
Constraints: The key check runs on the attribute name, so it catches plain string values. It does not catch a secret stored under an innocuous key name. Callbacks are still skipped separately in _get_llm_attributes.
applies: Key-name filtering for mlflow.crewai.autolog span attributes, agent/task/LLM field skipping and dict sanitization.
says: Maximum tokens and tokenizer configuration are missing from the model trace details screen.
Client secrets and authorization tokens are visible in plain text in execution traces.
The agent trace view should display token usage without leaking authentication credentials.
Mask sensitive API credentials and access tokens recorded in the agent trace timeline.
Why are authentication tokens showing up in the logged parameters of our agents?
search: Sensitive credential key filtering in mlflow.crewai.autolog uses _SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN across _set_sanitized_attribute, _get_agent_attributes, _get_task_attributes, _get_llm_attributes, and _sanitize_value dict keys. It filters keys containing api_key, apikey, secret, password, authorization, or credential, plus standalone, snake_case suffix, or camelCase suffix token (such as auth_token or accessToken), while preserving keys like max_tokens, tokenizer, and token_usage. The check matches attribute names to suppress plain string credential values, but cannot detect secrets stored under innocuous key names, and callbacks remain skipped separately in _get_llm_attributes.
